name: FormGroup
description: Fieldset wrapper for grouped form controls (checkbox set, radio set, named address block). Renders a real `<fieldset>` + `<legend>` so the grouping is announced.

keyboard: Tab — moves focus to the first focusable child control.
ariaRequirements: Renders a real `<fieldset>` element; `legend` becomes the accessible name of the whole group.
Disabled state on the fieldset cascades to all enclosed controls.
